title: Ultraverse Firearm Volume 1 Issue 2 October 1993 Rune Malibu Comics Graphic
descriptionText: The Ultraverse Firearm Volume 1 Issue 2 October 1993 comic book, by Malibu Comics, features the artistic skills of Barry Windsor-Smith. This single issue belongs to the Modern Age era of US Comics, with a genre encompassing action, superheroes, and adventure. The vibrant color style adds to the visual appeal of this collectible comic book from the United States, making it a must-have for fans of the Ultraverse series.
